article.title_es: New York Common Pantry: comedor y despensa en Manhattan
article.title_en: New York Common Pantry: soup kitchen and pantry in Manhattan
article.summary_es: New York Common Pantry es un comedor de sopa y despensa de alimentos en East Harlem, Manhattan. Ofrece comidas y alimentos según su horario.
article.summary_en: New York Common Pantry is a soup kitchen and food pantry in East Harlem, Manhattan. It offers meals and groceries according to its schedule.
how_they_help_es: Comedor de sopa de lunes a viernes de 2:30 pm a 3:30 pm.
Despensa de alimentos de miércoles a sábado de 10 am a 2:30 pm.
Abre los fines de semana para la despensa (sábado).
Está en 8 E 109th St, Nueva York, NY 10029.
how_they_help_en: Soup kitchen Monday to Friday, 2:30pm to 3:30pm.
Food pantry Wednesday to Saturday, 10am to 2:30pm.
Open on weekends for the pantry (Saturday).
Located at 8 E 109th St, New York, NY 10029.
visit_tips_es: El comedor y la despensa tienen horarios distintos; planifique su visita.
La despensa abre los sábados, pero el comedor no abre los fines de semana.
Llame antes de ir para confirmar los horarios y preguntar qué necesita.
visit_tips_en: The soup kitchen and pantry have different hours; plan your visit.
The pantry is open Saturdays, but the soup kitchen is not open on weekends.
Call ahead to confirm hours and ask what you need.
